title: Rental Vehicle Coordination Counter Options, Tolls, Fuel and Cleaning Charges
content:
**Clause.** Under Rental Vehicle Coordination, options and fees are the customer's on every coverage source and are charged per rental day actually rented:

1. the class additional driver fee per additional driver, with none for a spouse or domestic partner where the class lets the spouse or domestic partner drive free;
2. the class child seat price per seat, up to the class's most charged per seat;
3. the navigation unit, roadside protection, damage waiver and supplemental liability prices of the class, when the renter took them at the counter;
4. tolls at cost plus the class toll service fee per day a toll was used, the toll service fees capped at the class's most toll service fees per rental;
5. under the fuel policy (full to full), missing fuel at the class refuel charge per gallon;
6. the class smoking cleaning fee or pet cleaning fee when the partner reports it.

None of these is ever covered by an insurer or the network.

## Who pays

| Charge | Insurer | Network | Customer |
|---|---|---|---|
| Additional driver, child seat, navigation, roadside, damage waiver, supplemental liability | Never | Never | Always |
| Tolls and toll service fees | Never | Never | Always |
| Missing fuel | Never | Never | Always |
| Smoking or pet cleaning | Never | Never | Always |

## Hypothetical cases (prices from a class price list of 12.99 USD per additional driver, 13.99 USD per child seat day up to 69.95 USD per seat, 5.95 USD per toll day up to 29.75 USD)

- A renter on a 4-day rental adds a spouse and a friend as drivers: the spouse drives free and the friend costs 4 days at 12.99 USD, 51.96 USD.
- Two child seats on a 7-day rental: each seat would come to 97.93 USD and is held at 69.95 USD, so the two seats come to 139.90 USD.
- Tolls of 18.40 USD used on 2 days: the tolls at cost plus 2 toll service fees of 5.95 USD, 30.30 USD in all.
